name: demo
doc: Shapes, and the things done to them.

types.name: Identified
types.doc: Anything that can be told apart from another of its kind.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: The discriminator, pinned to one value so a union can be told apart.

functions.name: sort
functions.doc: Puts a list of integers in order. Says nothing about how, which is the point: several proofs of this exist and they differ in what they cost.

functions.name: mergesort
functions.doc: Sorting, but specifically by merging. A proof of this is also a proof of `sort`, so registering one here answers calls to either.

functions.name: label_of
functions.doc: Describes a rectangle. Written as a body rather than implemented, so it needs nobody to prove it and runs in every language once generated.
